Admin routes of the customers module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/customers

List all customers

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `search` in query (string, max length 100, optional).
- `segment` in query (`"NEW"`, `"ACTIVE"`, `"LOYAL"`, `"AT_RISK"`, `"CHURNED"`, `"HIGH_VALUE"`, `"VIP"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Customers retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## GET /v1/admin/customers/{id}

Get customer by ID

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Customer retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Customer not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/customers/{id}

Update customer

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateCustomerAdminDto](#updatecustomeradmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Customer updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Customer not found.

## GET /v1/admin/customers/segments

List customer segments with counts

Responses:

- `200`: Segments retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## Schemas

### UpdateCustomerAdminDto

- `firstName` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `lastName` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `email` (string, max length 254, optional).
- `phone` (string, max length 30, optional).
- `isActive` (boolean, optional).
